title: LTX 2.5 Creative Lab LoRAs, tested locally
summary: Lightricks has released a set of official LoRAs for LTX 2.5 that add things the base model does not do on its own, from building a shot out of a reference sheet to colouring a black-and-white film. I ran 14 of them in ComfyUI on my own desktop, plus three tests that chain two LoRAs in one generation.
Each test has a frame from every clip in it, the exact prompt, the workflow that ran and the inputs it was given. 25 of the 31 tests worked, and the other 6 show where a LoRA reached its limit.
facts: 14 official Lightricks LoRAs, of which 12 are IC-LoRAs guided by a video or an image
About 5 seconds each, mostly 121 frames at 24fps, at each LoRA's trained size or the largest size that worked
My RTX 3060 with 12GB, i5-13400F, 32GB RAM, PyTorch on CUDA 13

prompts.title: Character, prop and location

variants.label: Prompt
variants.text: Reference sheet: a portrait photo of a young woman with shoulder-length dark hair streaked pink and blue, large gold hoop earrings, a small tattoo on her neck and a beige knitted sweater; a product photo of a vintage yellow 35mm film camera with a black strap; a plain photo of an empty rooftop terrace with a brick parapet, potted olive trees and a city skyline. Generated video: the same woman is standing on the rooftop terrace at golden hour, lifting the yellow film camera to her eye, taking a photo of the skyline and then lowering it with a small smile toward the camera, in a static medium shot with a light breeze and distant traffic below.

variants.label: Negative
variants.text: worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted

verdict.label: Works
verdict.text: The woman, her yellow camera and the rooftop each come from a separate panel of the sheet, and they end up together in a new moving shot.

notes: The sheet follows the Lightricks demo layout: a 1536×896 black canvas, 16 px gutters and plain photo panels. Keeping to that sizing and those margins gave me better results.

prompts.title: Two characters from one sheet

variants.label: Prompt
variants.text: Reference sheet: Top Row Left (Character): a close-up of a young woman's face with long, voluminous curly copper-red hair, freckles across her nose and cheeks and grey-blue eyes. Top Row Right (Character): a close-up of a smiling young woman's face with long, voluminous curly dark-brown hair and dark eyes. Bottom Row Left (Prop): a red electric guitar with a white pickguard and a maple neck. Bottom Row Right (Setting): a small, empty jazz-club stage with a red velvet curtain, a wooden floor, a microphone stand and an upright piano. Generated video: On the small jazz-club stage in front of the red velvet curtain, the young woman with curly copper-red hair and freckles, wearing a cream t-shirt and blue jeans, stands on the left playing the red electric guitar with the white pickguard. On the right, the smiling young woman with long curly dark-brown hair, wearing a white crop top and cream trousers, sings into the microphone on its stand. They turn to smile at each other as they play, in a steady medium shot that shows both of them from the knees up, with warm stage lights on them and the upright piano behind. The sound is the electric guitar and her singing voice filling the small room.

verdict.label: Limit
verdict.text: I put two faces on one sheet to see whether both would hold. The scene, the guitar and the outfits came through. The guitarist's face stays hidden behind her hair, the singer does not clearly match the woman on the sheet, and her freckles turn into red marks on her arm.

notes: This run used large face panels, the prompt format from the model card and the outfits described in the prompt.

prompts.title: Grayscale market

variants.label: Prompt
variants.text: Reference shows a market stall under a striped awning where a bearded vendor in an apron is arranging fruit in wooden crates while a customer in a headscarf reaches for lemons, with a busy market crowd behind, rendered in monochrome under soft daylight. Edited shows the same scene with natural colors restored. COLORIZE a green and white striped awning, bright orange oranges, red apples and yellow bananas in pale wooden crates, the vendor in a blue apron with a grey beard, the customer in a dark red headscarf and coat, warm natural skin tones and a muted colorful crowd behind. Subject identity, framing, and background geometry are identical to the reference; only color information differs between reference and edited.

verdict.label: Works
verdict.text: I took a generated market clip, turned it grayscale and gave that to the LoRA. The colours it picked for the fruit, the vegetables, the awning and the clothes came out close to the original.

notes: The trigger is COLORIZE. The colours you name in the prompt are the colours you get.

prompts.title: A Bucket of Blood, 1959

variants.label: Prompt
variants.text: Reference shows a cluttered 1950s bohemian apartment where a smiling young woman with wavy shoulder-length hair, in a fitted cardigan, a wide belt and a dark skirt, holds a wicker handbag beside a grinning young man in a dark sweater and jeans, while a man in a dark suit with a cane stands by the doorway behind them and a tall sculpture draped in a sheet fills the right of the frame, rendered in monochrome film. Edited shows the same scene with natural colors restored. COLORIZE the woman with strawberry-blonde hair in a dusty-rose cardigan, a black leather belt and a charcoal skirt with a pale straw handbag, the young man with light-brown hair in a navy sweater and faded blue jeans, the man by the door in a black suit, an off-white canvas sheet over the sculpture, pale sage-green walls and cream doors, a warm yellow lampshade glowing above a dark wooden dresser, a worn red patterned sofa and warm natural skin tones. Subject identity, framing, and background geometry are identical to the reference; only color information differs between reference and edited.

verdict.label: Works
verdict.text: This is a real black-and-white film, so there is no colour original to check against. Every colour I named in the prompt lands, from the dusty-rose cardigan to the yellow lampshade, and the faces hold through the shot. The cane comes out red without being asked for.

notes: The film's own soundtrack is put back on the result after generation.

prompts.title: Running through Tokyo rain

outputs.label: No LoRA, slow motion in the prompt

facts: Same graph without the LoRA, seed 42, 6 min

variants.label: With the LoRA
variants.text: A medium close-up at night follows a young woman with long, curly copper-red hair and freckles as she runs down the middle of a narrow, wet Tokyo side street toward the camera, wearing a cream t-shirt and a bronze cross pendant on a long cord. Her arms pump, her curls bounce and swing around her face with each stride, and the pendant swings against her t-shirt. Light rain falls through the street, landing on her face and hair. The camera tracks her face, keeping it centred and in focus while it moves in a smooth arc around her, and the glowing neon signs, red paper lanterns and lit shop fronts behind her slide past, their pink, blue and amber light reflecting on the wet asphalt. The soundscape is her footsteps slapping on the wet street, her breathing, the patter of rain and the distant hum of the city, rendered with crisp high-resolution detail and moody, neon-lit cinematic colour.

variants.label: No LoRA
variants.text: Extreme slow-motion footage from a high-speed camera, every movement stretched out and unhurried. The red-haired young woman runs down the middle of the wet, neon-lit Tokyo street toward the camera. The camera tracks her face, holding it centred, close and in sharp focus while it swings in a smooth arc around her, the glowing signs and red lanterns sliding past behind her. Raindrops hang in the air around her face and burst into fine spray on her freckled cheek, every curl of her copper hair floats apart in the neon light, her arms pump and the cross pendant lifts off her cream t-shirt on its cord. A deep, stretched whoosh and the muffled patter of rain.

verdict.label: Works
verdict.text: The LoRA clip uses a plain caption of a normal-speed run, as the model card asks, and speed 0.2 alone slows it down. The clip without the LoRA has slow motion written into the prompt instead. That one runs faster and the effect comes and goes, while the LoRA holds it steady through the shot.

notes: Speed is set through the conditioning frame rate, which is 24 divided by the speed, so 120 here. Playback stays at 24fps. There is no trigger word.

prompts.title: Dove in flight

outputs.label: No LoRA, slow motion in the prompt

facts: Same graph without the LoRA, seed 42, 6 min

variants.label: With the LoRA
variants.text: A side-on medium shot follows a white dove flying from left to right low over a sunlit park in the early morning, the trees and grass behind it soft and out of focus. The dove beats its wings: they sweep down from high above its back, the long white flight feathers bending and spreading apart as they push against the air, then fold and rise again for the next stroke, while its fanned tail tilts and its head stays level, its eye fixed ahead. Low golden sunlight shines through the edges of the feathers and rims the bird in light; the camera pans smoothly with the dove to keep it in the frame. The soundscape is the soft, rhythmic whoosh of wing beats and birdsong in a quiet park, rendered with crisp high-resolution detail and warm natural colour.

variants.label: No LoRA
variants.text: Extreme slow-motion footage from a high-speed camera, every movement stretched out and unhurried. A side-on medium shot follows a white dove flying from left to right low over a sunlit park in the early morning, the trees and grass behind it soft and out of focus. The dove beats its wings: they sweep down from high above its back, the long white flight feathers bending and spreading apart as they push against the air, then fold and rise again for the next stroke, while its fanned tail tilts and its head stays level, its eye fixed ahead. Low golden sunlight shines through the edges of the feathers and rims the bird in light; the camera pans smoothly with the dove to keep it in the frame. The soundscape is the soft, rhythmic whoosh of wing beats and birdsong in a quiet park, rendered with crisp high-resolution detail and warm natural colour.

verdict.label: Works
verdict.text: Both clips have the same start still and the same caption. Without the LoRA the wings beat faster and the feather tips blur. With it each frame moves a little, and the flight feathers stay sharp and separate through the stroke.

notes: The clip without the LoRA mixed slow wings with a neck moving at normal speed, which looked unnatural to me.

prompts.title: Water into a sandbox

variants.label: Prompt
variants.text: Reference shows two young women kneeling side by side in a wooden sandbox full of dry golden sand in a sunny backyard, scooping sand in their hands, pouring sand from a red bucket and patting the sand. Edited shows the same scene with water added. ADD WATER clear shallow water flooding the whole sandbox and completely covering the sand up to their knees, rippling around their legs; water streaming out of their cupped hands and dripping from their fingers, the red bucket pouring a stream of water that splashes into the flooded sandbox, and their palms slapping the water surface into splashes and spreading rings of ripples. Subject identity, clothing, framing, and background geometry are identical to the reference; only water-related elements differ between reference and edited.

verdict.label: Works
verdict.text: This uses the card's prompt template on a clip of a dry sandbox. Water pools around their knees and the bucket pours water instead of sand. The sand around the edges stays dry, and the cream trousers on the right come out as light jeans.

notes: I also tried to replace all of the sand with water and could not get that to work. This LoRA is strict about the prompt format it expects. The trigger is ADD WATER.

links.label: The Water Simulation LoRA on Hugging Face

prompts.title: Heavily macroblocked market

variants.label: Prompt
variants.text: Reference shows a market stall under a green and white striped awning where a vendor with a grey beard in a blue apron is arranging oranges, red apples and yellow bananas in wooden crates while a customer in a dark red headscarf reaches for lemons, with a busy market crowd behind, heavily compressed with visible macroblocking, chroma bleed, and ringing artifacts. Edited shows the same scene restored to high quality with sharp detail, clean edges, and no compression artifacts. ENHANCE QUALITY a market stall under a green and white striped awning where a vendor with a grey beard in a blue apron is arranging oranges, red apples and yellow bananas in wooden crates while a customer in a dark red headscarf reaches for lemons, with a busy market crowd behind. Subject identity, framing, and background geometry are identical to the reference; only compression artifacts and image quality differ between reference and edited.

verdict.label: Works
verdict.text: I re-encoded a generated market clip at 120 kbps to break it into blocks. The LoRA removes the blocks, and the fruit and the crowd come back clean and close to the original.

notes: It came out so close to the original that I tried footage that was never clean next. The trigger is ENHANCE QUALITY, and it only helps footage that is badly damaged.

links.label: The Decompression LoRA on Hugging Face

Edited shows the same scene restored to high quality with sharp detail, clean edges, and no compression artifacts. verdict.label: Works
verdict.text: This is a 640×480 web copy of a film shot from the front of a cable car in San Francisco in 1906. One pass adds colour, removes the scratches and the flicker and adds detail, and the SIGHT lettering on the cable car survives. The far background, the distant people and the building fronts are rebuilt rather than recovered, because there was little detail there to begin with.

notes: The source is resized to the 1440×1088 canvas with lanczos and nothing else, then processed in 960×544 tiles. The prompt names the period, the place, the light and the clothing, and the negative names modern objects.

prompts.title: Town square, camera arc

variants.label: Prompt
variants.text: A young woman with long curly red hair, in a cream knitted sweater and blue jeans, stands beside a weathered sandstone fountain in a small European town square at golden hour as the camera slowly arcs around her and moves closer. Cream and ochre townhouses with shuttered windows, a café awning, a leafy plane tree, black iron street lamps, wooden benches and worn cobblestones, warm low sunlight with long soft shadows. Match the first frame. Photoreal.

verdict.label: Limit
verdict.text: I built the layout in Blender from primitives and made the look still from its first frame with Qwen-Image 2.1. The camera arc, the fountain, the tree and the lamp land where the layout put them. The box mannequin has no front, so she turns her back mid-shot. The nearest bench smears, and the empty sky in the layout became more houses.

notes: I have seen more side effects like these on busier layout animations, so I expect it to work better with simpler camera moves. The prompt matches the look still and leaves out the words clay and 3D.

paragraphs: Every test page has a zip with its workflow, every input it loads and a README listing the models it needs. Unzip it, copy the inputs into ComfyUI/input, put the models in the folders shown below and drag the workflow onto ComfyUI.

The workflows follow the official Lightricks templates, one graph per kind of LoRA. The model loaders and every ComfyUI-LTXVideo node stay in view; only core ComfyUI plumbing is folded into subgraphs, with the prompt and settings on them. Every workflow sizes its output from what you load with one setting, Shorter side, and the video ones take their length and frame rate from the clip, so they run on your own footage as they are. Every kind of workflow here was run from its downloadable file. The clips on these pages came from the original test graphs, with the same settings. If a node shows up red, install or update ComfyUI-LTXVideo to the commit listed rather than rewiring the graph.
The Lightricks repositories on Hugging Face, the LTX 2.5 base model and every LoRA, are gated. Log in, open each repository page and accept its terms before downloading, or the links return an error.
I ran everything on an RTX 3060 with 12GB of VRAM, an i5-13400F and 32GB of RAM. Peak VRAM across the tests was 7.5 to 11.8 GiB and each clip took 3 to 36 minutes.
